verdicts.reason: A is badly cramped. The headline nearly touches the top edge and 'fizz' runs into the two overlapping circles crammed into the top-right corner. The CTA is jammed against the right edge, the bottle touches the bottom, and the three-line subcopy is squeezed up against the button. B has more breathing room and a clear left-to-right flow (logo, bottle, headline, CTA on the green circle), but it has fixable flaws. The SOLSTICE logo is tiny and isolated. The subcopy is too small, with an orphaned 'sweet.' on its own line. The bottle almost touches the top and bottom edges.
